consensus_summary: Fans overwhelmingly praise the laid-back, mellow vibe of the show, highlighting the exceptional performances of several songs. The sound quality is noted as excellent, contributing to the overall enjoyment of the concert.
rating_rationale: 2.5 base + 0.4 for 86 reviews + 1.2 sentiment: The majority of reviews express high enthusiasm for the performance and sound quality, with many considering it one of the best shows of 1976.
